display_name: The Two Hundred Martyrs of Sinope

names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 7 Απριλίου, «Άγιοι Διακόσιοι Μάρτυρες οι εν Σινώπη», with the rank word Άγιοι left off. The number and the word Μάρτυρες are kept because they are what names the company; the page names none of the two hundred.

Read out of the day’s own line for 7 апреля ст. ст., «и с ними 200 воинов», which is how the calendar names the company. **The company has no name link of its own**: the day’s line carries two, for the deacon and for the woman, and the figure is plain text. It is a count and an office and not a personal name, which is what the calendar gives a company of two hundred nobody enumerates, and it is stored as the line prints it. No folder holds this form.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 7 апреля ст. ст. — «Мчч. Руфина диакона, Акилины и с ними 200 воинов (ок. 310).»

attestations.note: Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Απριλίου — «Άγιοι Διακόσιοι Μάρτυρες οι εν Σινώπη»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It names none of the two hundred, so this is one folder and not two hundred. It gives no year of death, only the reign of «τοῦ παρανόμου Δεκίου (249 - 251)» in the notice it quotes from Laura Codex 170, and no `dates` were taken from a reign. The page prints no hymn.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
